items.detail: Two of three legs hold; the CI leg does not. (a) package.json:34-36 declares "allowScripts": { "better-sqlite3": true }, and the probe is exactly the required one: package.json:32 "check:sqlite-binding": "bash scripts/postinstall-lint-deps.sh --sqlite-binding-only"; running `npm run check:sqlite-binding` printed "OK: better-sqlite3 native binding loads (SELECT 1 -> {\"x\":1})" with EXIT=0. (b) Remedy documented at README.md:39-88 ("Troubleshooting: `better-sqlite3` native binding (npm >= 12)", incl. `npm rebuild better-sqlite3` at README.md:75 and `npm install-scripts approve --no-allow-scripts-pin better-sqlite3` at README.md:80) and CHANGELOG.md:11-27. (c) MISSING: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` has no such step — `grep -n 'sqlite-binding\|better-sqlite3\|allowScripts' .github/workflows/ci.yml` returned EXIT=1 with no matches; ci.yml:49-50 is only `- name: Install dependencies / run: npm ci`. The step exists only as an unapplied patch at .coding-hermes/pending/ci-sqlite-binding-step.patch (added in 6cb184b4 at ci.yml:52-61, removed in e8343f1c). The repo's own closeout evidence .coding-hermes/evidence/DF-SPECLANG-7-closeout-2026-11-17.json records state "blocked — CI staging leg cannot land from this host (credential scope)" and what_is_missing.ci_step: ".github/workflows/ci.yml has no step running `npm run check:sqlite-binding`"; board row DF-SPECLANG-7 in .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl is status "blocked" with blocked_reason "CI wiring blocked ... tracked as INT-CI-1". The prior gitreins verdict .gitreins/history/2026-11-17/abfe0118/verdict.json graded this same criterion FAIL for this same missing CI step. A repo-wide grep for 'check:sqlite-binding' finds only package.json:32, scripts/postinstall-lint-deps.sh:81/93/105-106 and the evidence/patch files — no workflow, no test asserts the CI wiring.
